plan.notes: Source: official UAlbany Academic Advising four-year plan for Computer Science BS (https://www.albany.edu/academic-advising/four-year-plans/bs-computer-science), transcribed manually 2026-09-30; course prefix style (ICSI/AMAT/APHY/ACHM) follows the plan page. Catalog year 2024-2025: the advising page is undated, but its sequence (ICSI 333, 404, 412, 416, 418Y, 499) matches the BS curriculum for students matriculating BEFORE Fall 2025, verified against the 2022-2023 archived Undergraduate Bulletin course descriptions (https://www.albany.edu/undergraduate_bulletin_archive/2022-2023/I_csi.html). The current 2026-2027 Undergraduate Bulletin (https://www.albany.edu/undergraduate-bulletin/department-computer-science.php) revised the BS core for Fall 2025+ matriculants (required core: ICSI 201, 207, 210, 213, 300Z, 302, 311, 402, 403, 409, 410, 418, 424 or 426, 499; 77-credit combined major/minor) and publishes no term-by-term sequence for the new curriculum. True degree name per the 2026-2027 bulletin: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (Combined) (CSIC), ABET-accredited. Total 120 = the published B.S. minimum (https://www.albany.edu/undergraduate-bulletin/requirements-for-bachelors-degree.php). Credit modeling: Languages Other than English modeled at 3 cr (plan allows 3-5); Fall Year 1 science choice modeled at 3 cr on the APHY 140/142 physics option (the 4-cr ACHM 115 chemistry option adds 1 cr to that term). Progression gates from the plan page: grade of C or better in ICSI 201, ICSI 210 and ICSI 213 required to progress after year one; grade of C or better in ICSI 311 and ICSI 333 required after year two. Course titles and prereqs from the 2022-2023 archived bulletin (same curriculum generation). ICSI 499's official prereq is 'nine credits at the 400 level of computer science courses' (not expressible as named course codes; left empty). ICSI 300Z carries the CH GenEd tag in the plan. APHY 145's official pre/corequisite is APHY 140; modeled here as the Fall science choice slot (students choosing the ACHM 115 chemistry track should confirm the lab pairing with an advisor). Era title note: the 2022-2023 bulletin titles ICSI 333 'System Fundamentals' and ICSI 404 'Assembly Programming and Computer Organization'; the 2026-2027 bulletin renames them 'Program Hardware-Software Interface' and 'Computer Organization'.
